subject: Security onboarding runbook — SOC 2 packet & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@accelerator.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding runbook — SOC 2 packet & evidence timeline

Thanks for the call this morning, Samir — good alignment. Below is a concise runbook proposal for the security onboarding milestone we discussed (SOC 2 packet delivery + evidence intake). Please review and confirm owners/dates so we can lock the MAP milestones.

Proposed milestone: SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence bundle delivered to Accelerator.ai for review.
Target milestone deadline: 2027-08-20 (initial draft)
Overall close target: 2027-09-03 (contract execution / SOW signed)

Owners / responsibilities:
- Redwood: provide completed SOC 2 questionnaire (v1) and evidence manifest / transfer instructions — contact Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) — deliver by 2027-08-20
- Accelerator.ai: review questionnaire, flag any evidence gaps, and open a secure transfer channel (SFTP or OneDrive share) — contact security@accelerator.ai — respond by 2027-08-27
- Procurement (Accelerator.ai): review commercial SOW and run legal review in parallel — procurement@accelerator.ai — aim to confirm by 2027-08-31

Dependencies / notes:
- We will need a secure upload endpoint from your side; if SFTP is not available, we can share an encrypted ZIP via signed AWS presigned URL.
- Some artifact requests (e.g., internal change logs, vendor attestations) may require engineer time — note these on the manifest so we can scope assistance.
- Per our SLA conversation, for Dedicated deployment we may need an additional attestation; we will surface that if it’s requested.

Attachments referenced: SOC2_questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

Next steps:
1) Samir: confirm two things — (a) the secure transfer mechanism you prefer, and (b) if procurement needs a separate SOW template or PO terms.
2) Marissa: draft evidence manifest and prepare encrypted bundle (will attach in follow-up).
3) Priyom: prepare the SOW template and commercial timeline draft.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short MAP update (milestones + owners) once you confirm the transfer method.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Samir Patel <samir@accelerator.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: security@accelerator.ai, procurement@accelerator.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security onboarding runbook — SOC 2 packet & evidence timeline

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Agree with the approach; two clarifications from our side:

1) Evidence deadline: our security team has a heavy audit week the week of Aug 16. Can we move the evidence delivery to 2027-08-23 (review start 24th)? That gives us a little buffer.
2) Procurement asks that any SOW include a short section on data handling and regional hosting (we host in us-east by default). If you can include a one-page appendix, it will speed review.

We prefer an encrypted OneDrive share (we will create a protected folder and invite redwood-security@accelerator.ai once ready). I’ll have procurement/ops confirm the folder and send the invite.

Samir
Head of Platform & Security
Accelerator.ai
samir@accelerator.ai | +1 (646) 555-2247

Subject: Re: Security onboarding runbook — SOC 2 packet & evidence timeline

Thanks all — finalizing MAP updates below based on your inputs. I’ll add these milestones to the shared MAP doc (link included).

Finalized milestones (agreed):
- 2027-08-18: Redwood provides initial engineering artifacts (change logs, vendor attestations) — owner: Priyom Das
- 2027-08-20: Redwood uploads encrypted SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence manifest to Accelerator OneDrive (owner: Marissa Cole)
- 2027-08-24 to 2027-08-27: Accelerator security review window (owner: security@accelerator.ai)
- 2027-08-31: Procurement confirms SOW/comments; Redwood to provide one-page hosting appendix (owner: Jonas Weber)
- 2027-09-03: Target contractual close (SOW sign / PO issuance)

Dependencies: please confirm OneDrive invite by EOD 2027-08-06 so we can proceed with upload on the 20th. If OneDrive is delayed, we will fall back to a presigned S3 URL (we can provide encrypted files).

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-Example-Drive-Link
HubSpot: DEAL-ACC-2027-0911

If there are no objections I’ll add the above to the MAP and mark owners in HubSpot. Thanks — looking forward to the next checkpoint.
